description: This file defines the FileSystemMonitor class and related interfaces for monitoring file system changes on Linux and Windows platforms. It includes classes for handling callbacks, observing file system events, and managing platform-specific file system monitoring mechanisms.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor
classes.description: Platform-specific file system monitoring class for Linux and Windows, providing registration, unregistration, and notification mechanisms for file system changes.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects that are notified when a file system change occurs.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Context
classes.description: Internal class for managing platform-specific file system change notifications on Windows.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Dispatcher
classes.description: Thread class for processing file system events on Windows.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the FileSystemMonitor.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific file or directory to monitor changes.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback from monitoring a specific file or directory.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the monitor is properly initialized and valid.
